app.name: RiftWii
app.long_description:
RiftWii loads Riivolution-format mod packs (XML in sd:/riivolution) into Wii games from the disc, a USB drive or the SD card, and can keep modded saves on the SD card, apart from your Wii saves.
Games that have mods show as tiles; 1 switches to all games. Pick a game, open Mods, turn its packs on and pick their settings, and press Start. Games can also have cheats and picture settings.
USB and SD games need a d2x cIOS (slot 249, 250 or 251). The SD card must be FAT32; a USB drive may be FAT32 or NTFS.
Free software under the GPL, version 3 or later. It contains no Riivolution code.
